J1 is inferred to face x+ from its cable insertion center because no explicit footprint insertionDirection is defined, but should face y+ so the connector is accessible from the board edge. Set insertionDirection on the <footprint> to specify the actual direction in the footprint's unrotated orientation; for example, <footprint insertionDirection="from_above"> for a connector accessed from above the PCB (+Z).

J2 is inferred to face y- from its cable insertion center because no explicit footprint insertionDirection is defined, but should face y+ so the connector is accessible from the board edge. Set insertionDirection on the <footprint> to specify the actual direction in the footprint's unrotated orientation; for example, <footprint insertionDirection="from_above"> for a connector accessed from above the PCB (+Z).

J3 is inferred to face x+ from its cable insertion center because no explicit footprint insertionDirection is defined, but should face y- so the connector is accessible from the board edge. Set insertionDirection on the <footprint> to specify the actual direction in the footprint's unrotated orientation; for example, <footprint insertionDirection="from_above"> for a connector accessed from above the PCB (+Z).

J4 is inferred to face y+ from its cable insertion center because no explicit footprint insertionDirection is defined, but should face y- so the connector is accessible from the board edge. Set insertionDirection on the <footprint> to specify the actual direction in the footprint's unrotated orientation; for example, <footprint insertionDirection="from_above"> for a connector accessed from above the PCB (+Z).
